text: A dual trigger that relies on a financial institution index gains from its use of market prices but is vulnerable to index manipulation and to bondholders attempting to force the institution into bankruptcy.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Christoph Henkel, Contingent Capital with Sequential Triggers (2011). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=1908473
abstract: Although the strength of this proposal is its reliance on market prices, a disadvantage could be the index trigger, which could result in index manipulation or an attempt to force the entity into bankruptcy.

additionalProperty.name: scope_conditions
value: Applies to dual price trigger designs that include a sector or system index component
